errors.fileNotFound: {path} no longer exists in this worktree
errors.branchCheckedOutElsewhere: "{branch}" is checked out in {path}. Pull it in that worktree.
errors.branchRebasingElsewhere: "{branch}" is being rebased in {path}. Finish or abort the rebase there first.
errors.branchBisectingElsewhere: "{branch}" is being bisected in {path}. End the bisect there first.
errors.branchCheckedOutSwitchFirst: "{branch}" is checked out in {path}. Check out another branch there first.
errors.mergeCommitNotPickable: {sha} is a merge commit; {verb} does not support a merge commit
errors.gitTooOld: git {version} is older than the minimum {minVersion}
errors.deployNeeded: Repos in {distro} need nebegit's helper. Open the folder again to install it.
errors.wsl1Unsupported: WSL distro {distro} runs on WSL 1; nebegit needs WSL 2.
errors.pushFetchFirst: The remote has commits you don't have yet (fetch first). Pull first, or force push.
errors.pushNotFastForward: Your branch isn't a fast-forward of the remote (non-fast-forward). Pull first, or force push.
errors.pushStaleInfo: The remote moved since your last fetch (stale info). Pull first, or force push.
errors.pushRefUpdatedSinceCheckout: The remote has commits you fetched but haven't integrated (remote ref updated since checkout). Pull first, or force push.
errors.pushFirstRejected: The remote already has a branch of that name with commits this branch lacks. Nothing was pushed.
errors.branchDiverged: "{branch}" has diverged from its upstream and can't be fast-forwarded.
errors.authFailed: Could not sign in to the remote. Sign in once from a terminal (credential helper, SSH agent or cached login), then try again; nebegit never asks for, stores or sees credentials.
errors.invalidBranchName: "{name}" is not a valid branch name
errors.locked: Another program is using the repo (holding {lock}).
errors.squashDetached: HEAD is detached; squash and fixup need the current branch
errors.squashNotOnBranch: a selected commit is not on the current branch
errors.squashMergeInTheWay: the merge commit {sha} is in the way
errors.squashUncommittedChanges: there are uncommitted changes; commit or stash them first
errors.pullBlockedByChanges: Local changes are in the way of the pull.
errors.mergeBlockedByChanges: Local changes are in the way of the merge.
errors.rebaseBlockedByChanges: Local changes are in the way of the rebase.
errors.operationInProgress: A {operation} is in progress. Continue or abort it first.
errors.detachedHead: HEAD is detached. Check out a branch first.
errors.noOperation: No merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert is in progress.
errors.notReopenable: {path} was not resolved during this operation.
errors.operationNotSkippable: A {operation} can't be skipped; only a cherry-pick or revert can.
